verses.autre-muhammadun-ashraful-c1-v1: muḥammadu ʾashrafu l-ʾaʿrābi wal-ʿajami muḥammadu khayru man yamshī ʿalā qadami
verses.autre-muhammadun-ashraful-c1-v2: muḥammadu bāsiṭu l-maʿrūfi jāmiʿahu muḥammadu ṣāḥibu l-ʾiḥsāni wal-karami
verses.autre-muhammadun-ashraful-c1-v3: muḥammadu tāju rusli llāhi qāṭibaha muḥammadu ṣādiqu l-ʾaqwāli wal-kalimi
verses.autre-muhammadun-ashraful-c1-v4: muḥammadu thābitu l-mīthāqi ḥāfiẓuhu muḥammadu ṭayyibu l-ʾakhlāqi wash-shiyami
verses.autre-muhammadun-ashraful-c1-v5: muḥammadu khubiyat bin-nūri ṭīnatuhu muḥammadu lam yazal nūrā mina l-qidami
verses.autre-muhammadun-ashraful-c1-v6: muḥammadu ḥākimu bil-ʿadli dhū sharafi muḥammadu maʿdinu l-ʾinʿāmi wal-ḥikami
verses.autre-muhammadun-ashraful-c1-v7: muḥammadu khayru khalqi llāhi min muḍari muḥammadu khayru rusli llāhi kullihimi
verses.autre-muhammadun-ashraful-c1-v8: muḥammadu dīnuhu ḥaqqu nadīnu bihi muḥammadu mujmalu ḥaqqā ʿalā ʿalami
verses.autre-muhammadun-ashraful-c1-v9: muḥammadu dhikruhu rūḥu liʾanfusinā muḥammadu shukruhu farḍu ʿalā l-ʾumami
verses.autre-muhammadun-ashraful-c1-v10: muḥammadu zīnatu d-dunyā bahjatuhā muḥammadu kāshifu l-ghummāti waẓ-ẓulami
verses.autre-muhammadun-ashraful-c1-v11: muḥammadu sayyidu ṭābat manāqibuhu muḥammadu ṣāghahu r-raḥmānu bin-niʿami
verses.autre-muhammadun-ashraful-c1-v12: muḥammadu ṣafwatu l-bārī wakhīratuhu muḥammadu ṭāhiru min sāʾiri t-tuhami
verses.autre-muhammadun-ashraful-c1-v13: muḥammadu ḍāḥiku liḍ-ḍayfi mukrimuhu muḥammadu jāruhu willāhi lam yuḍami
verses.autre-muhammadun-ashraful-c1-v14: muḥammadu ṭābati d-dunyā bibiʿthatihi muḥammadu jāʾa bil-ʾāyāti wal-ḥikami
verses.autre-muhammadun-ashraful-c1-v15: muḥammadu yawma baʿthi n-nāsi shāfiʿunā muḥammadu nūruhu l-hādī mina ẓ-ẓulami
verses.autre-muhammadun-ashraful-c1-v16: muḥammadu qāʾimu lil-hi dhū himami muḥammadu khātimu lir-rusli kullihimi
